import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 10000100;
    static final int INF_LIMIT = 1000000007;
    static final int MOD_LIMIT = 1000000007;
    static final int P_CONST = 6151;
    static final int T_CONST = 2000;
    static final int SQ_CONST = 280;
    static final int LOG_SZ = 64;
    static final int LOG2_SZ = 34;

    static int total_nums, base_d;
    static List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
    static node[] node_obj = new node[LOG_SZ];
    static node[] helper_obj = new node[LOG_SZ];
    static node temp_node_obj2 = new node();

    static class node {
        long[][] matrix = new long[LOG2_SZ][LOG2_SZ];
        long[][] temp = new long[LOG2_SZ][LOG2_SZ];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[LOG2_SZ];
        boolean[] toggled = new boolean[LOG2_SZ];

        void merge(node other) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= base_d; k++) {
                        matrix[i][j] = (matrix[i][j] + matrix[k][j] * other.matrix[i][k]) % MOD_LIMIT;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                if (visited[i] && !other.visited[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                        matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j];
                    }
                }
                if (!visited[i] && other.visited[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                        matrix[j][i] = other.matrix[j][i];
                    }
                }
                visited[i] |= other.visited[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        void reset() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = 0;
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void shift(int shift_value) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < base_d; j++) {
                    int ni = (i + shift_value) % base_d;
                    int nj = (j + shift_value) % base_d;
                    temp[ni][nj] = matrix[i][j];
                }
                temp[(i + shift_value) % base_d][base_d] = matrix[i][base_d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                temp[base_d][(i + shift_value) % base_d] = matrix[base_d][i];
            }
            temp[base_d][base_d] = matrix[base_d][base_d];

            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = temp[i][j];
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                toggled[i] = visited[(i + shift_value) % base_d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                visited[i] = toggled[i];
            }
        }
    }

    static node fetch_node(int x) {
        int h = x, pw = 1, t_idx = -1;
        while (h >= base_d) {
            h /= base_d;
            pw *= base_d;
            t_idx++;
        }
        x %= pw;
        if (t_idx == -1)
            return helper_obj[h];
        node res_node = node_obj[t_idx];
        temp_node_obj2 = node_obj[t_idx];
        for (int i = 1; i < h; i++) {
            temp_node_obj2.shift(1);
            res_node.merge(temp_node_obj2);

        temp_node_obj2 = node_obj[t_idx];
        temp_node_obj2 = fetch_node(x);
        temp_node_obj2.shift(h);
        res_node.merge(temp_node_obj2);
        return res_node;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < LOG_SZ; i++) {
            node_obj[i] = new node();
            helper_obj[i] = new node();
        }
        int total_nums_input = sc.nextInt();
        base_d = sc.nextInt();
        total_nums = total_nums_input - 1;
        int temp_total = total_nums;
        while (total_nums > 0) {
            digits.add(total_nums % base_d);
            total_nums /= base_d;
        }
        node_obj[0].matrix[base_d][base_d] = 2;
        node_obj[0].matrix[base_d][0] = -1;
        node_obj[0].matrix[0][base_d] = 1;
        node_obj[0].visited[0] = true;

        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= digits.size(); i++) {

            temp_node_obj2 = node_obj[i - 1];
            for (int j = 1; j < base_d; j++) {

            }
        }
        node final_result = fetch_node(temp_total);
        System.out.println(final_result.matrix[base_d][base_d]);
